speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Do you think colors are important?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: Yes, I think they are. It's like buying a phone — when I buy a phone, I consider the color. And if I buy a car, I'll definitely consider the color too. It's actually more important for a car, because you can put a case on your phone, but a car... the color is about first impressions. If someone rides in your car, they'll have thoughts about your personality just from how it looks.
